recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑旁有大片黏著樣排列的大型異型細胞，細胞質豐富嗜酸至雙染性、核呈泡狀並有明顯核仁，部分核呈腎形或馬蹄形，並可見多個核分裂，符合 ALCL 侵犯骨髓。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm, mimicking a cohesive carcinoma
Vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli; some kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nuclei suggestive of hallmark cells
Frequent mitotic figures scattered through the infiltrate
Interspersed eosinophils and residual small hematopoietic cells
Bony trabecula at lower left with diffuse replacement of the adjacent marrow space
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular space adjacent to a bony trabecula that is extensively replaced by sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm. The neoplastic cells have vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli, some with reniform or horseshoe shapes, and mitotic figures are frequent; scattered eosinophils and residual hematopoietic cells are intermixed. The cohesive sheet-like growth can mimic metastatic carcinoma. Findings are consistent with involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by strong uniform CD30 and ALK immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is keratin positive and melanoma S100/SOX10 positive, whereas ALCL is CD30 and ALK (or EMA) positive and keratin negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are scattered in a mixed inflammatory background and are CD15+, PAX5 weak, CD45- and ALK-, rather than forming sheets.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: It expresses B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5, CD79a) and is ALK negative.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS shows variable, heterogeneous CD30 and lacks the uniform strong CD30 with hallmark cells and ALK rearrangement.
